description: Points marquants du réseau routier régional is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Service public de Wallonie Mobilité et Infrastructures. This collection of data consists of the following data layers: - Motorway areas; - Carpooling areas; - Crossings (trafic lights and roundabouts); - Interchanges and motorways; - Structures (bridges, tunnels, retaining walls); - Level crossings; - Pedestrian crossings ("school proximity" and others). Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in HTML. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are RTTI. The portal shows 2026-09-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
